findings.claim: filter_untracked (was count_untracked) silently adds exclusion of .serena/ and .DS_Store entries from the UNTRACKED column / removal-safety count, changing the remove-safety gate's behavior without any plan document, driver, decision, or test backing it.
findings.fix: Confirm this was intentional and, if so, add it to a plan/changelog so the remove-safety gate's widening has a paper trail.

findings.claim: GitRevParse is declared, exported, and exercised only by git_test.go with no production caller, leaving a public API surface with no caller.
findings.fix: Either wire it in where the plan implied it was needed, or drop it.

findings.claim: saveProfileSelection and internal/config/installenv.go both read from repo-relative paths rather than an injected root, adding second and third instances of the same implicit CWD==repo-root contract.
findings.fix: Add a one-line doc comment noting "assumes CWD == repo root" so a future caller does not get bitten silently.

findings.claim: handleReposAdd's new git init -b main side effect runs unconditionally for any existing directory without .git, mutating a directory on disk with git init and no confirmation step.
findings.fix: Add a note in the UI copy if not already present.

findings.claim: Several new German i18n catalog entries mix straight sentence punctuation with the more terse existing entries, and i18n prose quality is not mechanically checkable here.
findings.fix: Give it a proofreading pass by a native speaker before it reaches a real casual/German install.
